Incredible Crash Dummies, The.name: The Incredible Crash Dummies
Incredible Crash Dummies, The.summary: At a time when computer games were being blamed for violence, bad language, epilepsy and everything else the 'moral majority' needed a scapegoat for, Virgin gave us: The Road Safety Game. Or not, as this is a standard platform game with a twist of questionable taste and purpose.

NFL '95.name: NFL '95
NFL '95.summary: Ready for some Football! Sega Sports kicks off the season with reckless abandon and all the sticks of the Real NFL. The stars are here: Montana, Young, Elway, E. Smith, Rice, Sanders, White...in the most realistic Sega Genesis Football game of all time.
